description: CPP-only ConfigBase semantic probes for indexed relative values and the coPercent ratio downcast regression.

mutants.description: Read the base travel-speed ratio from slot zero instead of the matching slot for nullable indexed percentages; the second-slot result becomes 75% of 40 = 30 instead of 45.
Resolve a coPercent option against a base of 1 instead of its ratio_over base (layer height); the generated ironing-flow settings give 0.5 instead of 0.1 for a 50% ratio over layer height 0.2.
